svc_chain.reduction_order: per half: each column folds lower -> upper, then the upper row toward the centre (W half cols 0 -> 3, E half cols 7 -> 4), then W + E at the centre fold; fixed, compiler-visible; S81U-1 must match the golden head-dim reduction order (open item 3)
svc_chain.entry_note: p4j: q / P.V enter at the slice under the slice-column void (W rsv_05, E rsv_11) -- the centre roots rsv_07 / rsv_09 sit under frames f_3R01 / f_4L01, so a direct q/P.V lane crosses a frame body (p4i). q broadcasts outward from the entry (incl. entry -> root); partials run toward the root (entry -> root on tp); the folded result returns root -> entry on tr (512 b), then pv to the slice. Same reduction order as p4i.

host_in.why: f_host / f_lf / f_ks in, t_host / t_kd out (703 b) have no on-die source: the host and kit words arrive on the cross-die links, whose end-slice link endpoint (ot_s81ph_link_ep + gbx + coll lane) S81-SLICE has not built; the column-4 void is reachable only through the lane margins, so a dedicated host lane would run end slice -> top strip -> column 4 (~23 mm, ~57 stations x 703 b, +5% bit-mm) -- decide with the endpoint (S81-SLICE / S81U-SEQ)
